_comment: One secret-pattern source for Python has_secret and Node containsSecret. Flags are case-insensitive except card/date/url. A card match must stand alone (no letter or digit touching it) and pass the Luhn check, so hex hashes and ids cannot trip it. Both sides run them ASCII-only on normalized text (NFKC, casefold, whitespace/control to space, non-ASCII letter to x, digit to 0); Stripe keys have no leading word boundary so a placeholder letter before them cannot hide them. A password/api-key keyword alone is prose; it is held only when a value follows it (after : or = when the value has a digit or symbol or is 8+ characters, so 'KEY: in other-file.md' is prose; or after 'is' when the value has a digit or symbol).
